abilities.effect: The pitcher attempts to counteract the spell (counteract level 1, counteract modifier +10). On a success, the pitcher immediately consumes the spell as it passes over the plant.
abilities.name: Devour Magic
abilities.trigger: A spell's direct line of effect passes within a 5-foot-radius of the plant

hazard.description: A large pitcher plant occupying a 5-foot space sits seemingly dormant with its dull petals open.
hazard.disable: DC 15 Arcana (trained) to safely trigger the plant's reflexes, causing it to close and become dormant for one day, or DC 17 Nature (trained) to carefully coax the pitcher into quiescence
hazard.name: Spell Pitchers
hazard.reset: Once the pitcher has eaten a spell, its petals turn dark pink and green before it closes. It goes dormant for one day per spell level of the spell consumed. Once the pitcher finishes digesting, it opens again and slowly wilts. A second pitcher branches into an adjacent square when the first pitcher opens again.
hazard.stealth: DC 20 (trained) to recognize the plant among others

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
